# Module: `icescopy_sample_catalog`

Qt model, delegates, and panel actions for editing sample metadata.

[Source](../src/icescopy_sample_catalog.py) | [API index](API-Reference.md)

The tree model presents sample rows and field rows using the active schema. Edits validate field types and propagate fields marked “same for all” across the catalog. The panel mixin coordinates selection and persistent editors.

## Classes

| Class | Role |
| --- | --- |
| [`SampleCatalogNode`](API-Class-SampleCatalogNode.md) | Internal tree node for a sample or one of its metadata fields. |
| [`SampleCatalogTreeModel`](API-Class-SampleCatalogTreeModel.md) | Maps sample IDs and schema fields into an editable two-column Qt model. |
| [`SampleCatalogTreeDelegate`](API-Class-SampleCatalogTreeDelegate.md) | Creates and commits editors appropriate to each metadata field type. |
| [`SampleCatalogTreeView`](API-Class-SampleCatalogTreeView.md) | Customizes the catalog tree’s branch drawing. |
| [`SampleCatalogPanelMixin`](API-Class-SampleCatalogPanelMixin.md) | Builds the catalog panel and coordinates sample creation, deletion, and editor refresh. |
